aboutText: The Congolese Agency for the Promotion of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (ACPDPH) is a national non-governmental organization under Congolese law, established in accordance with Law No. 004/2001 of July 20, 2001 governing non-profit associations. Based in Beni, North Kivu province, it operates daily for self-reliance, inclusive education access, and safeguarding fundamental rights for persons with disabilities.
